text:
Maya: Posted an MVP PRD for variant routing across chat/completions/embeddings/rerank. Need quick review on acceptance criteria, canary gates, and a minimal ops runbook. link: https://redwood.internal/specs/mvp-variant-routing
Soren: reading. Top priorities: deterministic rerank tie-breaker, explicit embedding dim metadata, and a cost budget check for hosted tier.
Anika: suggest canary: 0.5% -> 3% -> 20% -> 100% with 10m observation windows. Gate on three metrics: precision@5 (quality), p95 latency, and 5xx rate. Auto-rollback if precision@5 drops >2% or p95 crosses route SLO twice consecutively.
Rao: ops note: default batch_wait=100ms is too high for low-latency routes. Recommend two profiles: lowlat (batch_wait=20ms, max_batch=16) and highthroughput (batch_wait=80ms, max_batch=256). Also need exact CLI commands in runbook to shift traffic and pin models.
Maya: adding profiles and runbook bullets. Acceptance criteria proposal:
- rerank determinism: same input+seed => stable order 99.995%
- fallback: if primary p95 >150ms for 2 consecutive windows -> route to fallback variant preserving schema
- cost: average cost per 1k tokens <= 115% of baseline for hosted customers
- embeddings: responses include metadata key "dim" with integer value for compatibility
Soren: add tie-breaker for zero-score ties: prefer ingestion_timestamp then deterministic id_hash. Document behavior for partial responses when KV cache warms: return partial + X-RW-Partial header and retry semantics.
Anika: for canary assignment use deterministic user-id hashing to split traffic; exclude internal bot IDs from metrics. Also propose recording canary cohort in traces for easy filtering.
Rao: runbook minimal steps to include:
- command to force route to fallback
- revoke canary traffic and immediate rollback CLI
- how to pin a model at edge for hotfix
- postmortem checklist link
ops-bot: [checklist] PRD link reachable, lint OK
Maya: thanks. I'll update PRD with these items and paste the runbook CLI snippets. Please reply with LGTM or blockers by EOD so I can schedule cross-team review.
Soren: LGTM pending tie-breaker line be explicit.
Anika: LGTM.
Rao: LGTM after runbook CLI added.
